title: Where my money goes
blurb: Write down what you spend as it happens. It adds it up by month and by category for you.
best_for: Keeping an eye on spending without a spreadsheet, an app or an account.

asks.label: What are the groups you want to sort things into?
asks.help: One per line. These become the buttons you press when you add something.

changing: The groups are the lines in categories.txt - edit it and refresh the page.
Everything you write down is in data/expenses.csv, an ordinary spreadsheet. You can fix a typo there by hand if you prefer.
The currency symbol is on the line that says CURRENCY near the top of start.py - change it there and restart the app.
Nothing is connected to a bank. It only knows what you type into it.

map.run.bat: double-click to start it on Windows
map.run.sh: double-click to start it on macOS or Linux
map.categories.txt: the groups you sort spending into - edit freely
map.serve.py: the engine (you never need to open this)
